title: A Lipschitz map with Hoelder derivative on a full-measure set is C^1 with the same Hoelder bound
statement: Let n, l >= 0, f : R^n -> R^l, c in R^n, r real, K >= 0, Z a subset of R^n, and M, R, alpha real with M >= 0, R > 0 and alpha > 0. Assume f is K-Lipschitz on the open ball B := B^o_r(c), Z is contained in B, B minus Z is Lebesgue-null, f is differentiable at every point of Z, and hsNorm(Df(x) - Df(y)) <= M (||x - y||/R)^alpha for all x, y in Z, where Df = fderiv f and hsNorm is the Hilbert-Schmidt norm. Then f is C^1 on B (ContDiffOn R 1 f B) and hsNorm(Df(x) - Df(y)) <= M (||x - y||/R)^alpha for all x, y in B.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (c : Rn n) (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (Z : Set (Rn n)) (M R α : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 < R → 0 < α → LipschitzOnWith K f (ball c r) → Z ⊆ ball c r → volume (ball c r \ Z) = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → (∀ x ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ Z, hsNorm (fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y) ≤ M * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball c r) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball c r, ∀ y ∈ ball c r, hsNorm (fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y) ≤ M * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α
